texts: mixed: the rule fires and every participant is carried (each Keeper, the taking, the sea-water, the source), but "the Salt-bloom Tide-pools" is recorded as one named individual of kind tide-pool — a capitalised multi-word name has no way to say the referent is several pools, so the plurality of the source is lost. If the plural matters, lowercase the common-noun head so it parses as an ordinary definite plural tied to the name: "Each Keeper takes the sea-water from the Salt-bloom tide-pools."
